scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved using explicit weighted-composition columns, Gaussian boundary concentration, Riemann–Lebesgue cross-term decay, and convergence of resonant squared column norms; the finite numerical checker is supporting evidence only. No independent review or definitive priority determination has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite distinct atoms in (0,1) only; imaginary-power multipliers only; sharp coefficient is for monomial-degree truncation, not general singular values; earlier single weighted-composition Hilbert–Schmidt criteria cover single-atom membership; possible indirect stronger statements in classical finite-sum weighted-composition literature.
title: Arithmetic Hilbert–Schmidt resonance and a Gaussian column-energy law for atomic Hausdorff commutators
